caption:
On John Collison's Cheeky Pint podcast, Mark Zuckerberg said Meta was ready to "write this check for like, I don't know, $100 billion, $200 billion."
He recalled asking Alexandr Wang: "Alex, are you sure this is going to work?"
His case for the bet: "In order for it not to work out, it's not just that we have to fail, AI overall has to fail."

Would you write a $200 billion check on AI?
